# In a linked worktree (`git worktree add`) .git is a file pointing at the
# shared git dir. sesam must still see HEAD there, or checks that compare
# against committed history silently switch off.

exec git init
exec git config user.email test@sesam.dev
exec git config user.name 'Sesam Test'

exec sesam init --user admin --install-hooks=false
exec git add -A
exec git commit -m 'init sesam'

exec git worktree add ../wt -b wt
cd ../wt

# A committed but unapplied declaration is refused without --force, the same
# as in the main worktree.
cp $WORK/x.txt x.txt
exec sh -c 'printf "  - path: x.txt\n" >> sesam.yml'
exec git add sesam.yml
exec git commit -m 'declare x.txt'
! exec sesam config apply
stderr 'committed'

-- x.txt --
secret
